input:
Handlers are spending too much time fixing the incorrect file type assignments — we need a better way to classify garage estimates so we don’t miss critical evidence during claims processing.
Handlers waste time fixing incorrect file type assignments for garage estimates.

Our commercial claims are too complex for auto-routing — we need manual claim routing for those, while motor claims can stay automated by postcode and workload.
The system cannot manually route complex commercial claims while keeping motor claims automated.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal — it’s not letting me in despite multiple attempts.
User cannot log in because the password reset is failing.

we’re having trouble pulling the latest reserves report for a high-value marine claim
The user cannot pull the latest reserves report for a high‑value marine claim.

We’ve got a few workflow hiccups I’d like to flag.
The user is encountering workflow hiccups while using the platform.

We’re still waiting on those claim progress messages to go live — the team’s keen to get policyholders auto-notified at key stages.
The claim progress notification feature is not yet live, preventing automatic updates to policyholders.

Yes, that’d be helpful — especially if we can see how reserves and payments sync with supplier updates in real time.
The platform lacks a real‑time view of how reserves and payments sync with supplier updates.

The unexpected interface changes have forced us to retrain staff mid-cycle, which is causing errors in our claims and payments processing — we really need advance notice and bundled releases next time.
Unexpected interface changes force staff retraining mid‑cycle, leading to errors in claims and payments processing.

we’ll manage with single uploads for now and look forward to the multiple file upload improvement.
Customers must upload each document individually because bulk upload is not yet available.

we’re still stuck calling garages manually because the system doesn’t show live repair updates — it’s a daily headache...The repair updates missing is a daily blocker — we have to call every garage to get status
The system does not provide live repair updates, forcing manual calls to garages.

We keep getting error messages that say Keelwater is down, but I think it’s actually our own customer network failure — maybe the sign-on provider or our corporate VPN is interfering with the login flow.
Customers see error messages claiming Keelwater is down even when the issue is likely their own network or VPN.

just wish it wasn’t part of our daily workflow.
Customers have to follow up by phone because the platform lacks real-time repair status updates.

Our team’s been unable to access Keelwater this morning — it looks like a customer login outage, but we haven’t touched our SSO setup, and it’s impacting multiple staff.
The team cannot log into Keelwater due to a login outage.

we’ve got a couple of ... claims held up because the ... approver’s ...  …  …  …  ...  … ... … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … …… …………………………………………………………
Claims are stuck waiting for approval because there is no backup approver.

It’s about the interface — we’ve had to retrain our claims team twice in three months because of unannounced screen changes. It’s disruptive and costly.
Unannounced interface changes force the claims team to undergo repeated, costly retraining.

That’s helpful, but we’ve had a few cases where the system choked on large batches — maybe a bug or limit?
The platform crashes or slows down when handling large batch uploads.

We need to generate formal correspondence in letters in Welsh for our policyholders in Wales — it’s non-negotiable for us.
The product cannot generate formal correspondence letters in Welsh.

We don’t want to force one approach across all teams. Per-team configuration would solve it. We really need per-team configuration because our commercial team handles complex claims and prefers manual claim routing — one-size-fits-all doesn’t work for us.
The platform lacks per‑team configuration for claim routing, forcing a one‑size‑fits‑all approach.

Exactly. It’s not just inconvenient — it’s holding up payments and supplier invoices too.
The approval waiting list is delaying payments and supplier invoices.

We’re experiencing a reserve authorisation delay because when a handler tries to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it sits waiting for one specific approver who’s out of office and has no delegate assigned, so nothing moves.
Handlers cannot get reserve adjustments approved when the required approver is out of office and has no delegate, causing delays.

One last thing—can we also look at how supplier integrations work with our current policyholder data?
The customer wants to see how supplier integrations operate with their existing policyholder data.

we need a sandbox environment to test fraud detection rules before rolling them out live — can that be prioritized? ... We’re risking false positives in production without a safe testing environment.
Customers cannot test fraud detection rules safely because there is no sandbox environment.

Our commercial and specialty claims handlers find auto-routing unhelpful — we need manual claim routing to manage complex files properly, especially with multiple suppliers and policyholders involved.
Auto-routing does not handle complex commercial claims with multiple suppliers and policyholders, requiring manual routing.

the dashboard totals don’t match the CSV exports, causing export figures mismatch headaches
Dashboard totals are inconsistent with CSV export values.

I’m having trouble with the dashboard totals not matching the CSV we export for finance.
The dashboard totals do not match the data in the exported CSV file.

we’re seeing claims stuck because reserve changes need approval but no one’s covering for the approver right now.
Claims are getting stuck because reserve changes require approval and there is no approver available.

We’ve got a claim where we need to split a payment across several payees — not sure how to handle that in the system.
The user cannot figure out how to split a payment across multiple payees in the system.

We often need to upload files together when opening a new claim, especially when policyholders send in bundles. Right now, it’s one by one, which slows us down.
Users have to upload claim files one by one, which slows down the claim creation process.

Our month-end close depends on reconciling those numbers accurately.
They cannot reconcile numbers accurately for month‑end close.

I’m trying to upload the latest documents for a claim under policyholder J. Whitmore, but the system won’t accept the supplier’s invoice format.
The system rejects the supplier’s invoice format when trying to upload claim documents.

It’s affecting how we handle reserves and policyholder updates.
The platform is causing issues with handling reserves and policyholder updates.

We’re still wrestling with the wrong document category issue — garage estimates keep landing in Correspondence, and our handlers have to manually move them, which risks missing critical evidence.
Garage estimate documents are being auto‑categorized incorrectly, requiring manual re‑classification and risking missed evidence.

Could you walk me through how to attach documents to a claim in the system? I’m not seeing the upload button on the claims tab.
The user cannot find the upload button to attach documents to a claim.

Finance keeps comparing the MI dashboard totals with the CSV export and finds them off—this export figures mismatch is causing distrust in the numbers they use for monthly reporting.
The CSV export totals do not match the MI dashboard totals, causing distrust in the data.

They’re ... on SSO through ... IdP — we haven’t ... but it ... since this morning .
Users cannot log in via SSO because authentication is failing.

We’ve been reviewing how claims and documents flow through our current system, and it’s causing delays in reserves and payments.
The current system causes delays in reserves and payments.

It’s not just the layout — it’s the unexpected interface changes that threw off our team’s workflow and caused delays in processing reserves.
Unexpected interface changes disrupted the team's workflow and caused processing delays.

I was wondering if there’s a way to use keyboard shortcuts in claim notes to speed up data entry — it’d save us a lot of time during busy periods.
The product lacks keyboard shortcuts for claim notes, slowing down data entry.

I’m having trouble pulling the latest documents for a policyholder claim — can you check if there’s a permissions issue?
The user cannot retrieve the latest claim documents, possibly due to a permissions issue.

Can you also show how documents are versioned and linked to specific claims? We’ve had issues with that before.
Customers struggle with versioning documents and linking them to specific claims.

we’ve got a few policyholders asking when they’ll get updates during their claim process. Is there a way to automate those messages?
Policyholders cannot receive automated status updates during the claim process.

The approval waiting list just sits there if the approver’s out.
The approval waiting list stalls when the approver is unavailable, causing delays in processing reserves that exceed the limit.

Just the basics — smoother integrations, real-time updates, and less manual chasing.
The current integrations are clunky, updates are not real‑time, and users have to chase information manually.

when a policyholder reports the same incident both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t alert us — it just creates two separate claims.
Duplicate incident reports from phone and web portal are not flagged, resulting in separate claims.

I’m having trouble accessing our claims dashboard — I think I might need to reset my password to get back in and update some supplier payments.
The user cannot access the claims dashboard because they need to reset their password.

Reports: click "Export CSV", error exception
Exporting a CSV from the Reports page throws an error.

the system’s not showing the supplier invoices correctly
The system does not display supplier invoices correctly when reconciling claims payments.

we’re having some trouble navigating the claims module after the last update — ... things aren’t ... where we left ...
The claims module navigation is confusing after the recent update.

Suppliers: click "Open"
Suppliers: click "Save", rage x3
The supplier interface is unresponsive or fails when trying to open and save.

Could you walk me through how to update the reserves section after a claim is approved?
User doesn't know how to update the reserves section after a claim is approved.

Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble attaching the right files to the claim — it keeps rejecting them even though I’m sure they’re the correct format.
The platform rejects file attachments even when they are in the correct format.

Our motor team handles high-volume cases and wants automatic assignment based on postcode and workload... manual claim routing slows them down too much.
The motor team needs automated claim routing by postcode and workload, but the current system only supports manual routing.

That’d be great — I also need to sync up on the tasks for policyholders and make sure the integrations are pulling correctly.
The user needs to sync tasks for policyholders and verify that integrations are pulling data correctly.

are we able to customize the letters sent to policyholders for specific claim types?
The customer cannot find a way to customize letters sent to policyholders for specific claim types.

when a handler needs to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it goes into an approval waiting list — but if the approver’s out, nothing moves.
The approval waiting list blocks progress when the designated approver is unavailable.

we’re running claims reports late into the evening and the bright interface is straining our eyes...Any chance we can get dark mode enabled?
The user cannot use a dark mode, causing eye strain during late‑night claim report work.

Some tasks are getting stuck in the queue.
Tasks are getting stuck in the queue because of how roles are assigned to claims handlers.

I’ve got a few things I need help with on the claims platform — mostly around documents and reporting.
The user is having difficulty with documents and reporting on the claims platform.

our motor team wants more automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but commercial prefers manual control for complex cases
The motor team needs automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but the current system relies on manual control for complex cases.

I need to reset my password for accessing the claims documents portal — can you guide me through that?
The user cannot access the claims documents portal because they need to reset their password.

our finance team noticed the export figures mismatch with what’s shown in the dashboard, which is causing delays... they can’t trust which numbers to use for month-end reporting.
Exported figures do not match the numbers shown in the dashboard, causing trust issues and reporting delays.

I’m not seeing the option under payments or tasks right now.
The user cannot find the option to split a payment under payments or tasks.

I’m managing several claims with lots of supporting documents, and doing them one by one is slowing things down.
Users have to add supporting documents to claims one by one, which is slow.

Also, the document upload system keeps ... assigning the wrong category — say, putting repair quotes under correspondence — which leads ... incorrect file type issues.
The document upload system assigns uploaded files to the wrong category.
